name: launch-measure-scale proof dashboard
looks: A three-word headline stacked in three weights (bold, grey, italic) sits beside a dark analytics card: a 'live' status badge, a big multiplier number, and a green line climbing left to right with a value pill and a small caption line below it.
build: The stacked headline lines reveal with a short stagger. The card is a DOM panel with a live-glow badge (box-shadow pulse); the spline draws across with strokeDashoffset, a dot following the line's end point, and a value pill springing up near the peak (response ~0.38, damping ~0.8).
sound: A soft whoosh as the card lands, a rising tone under the line draw, a chime as the value pill pops.
prompt: Pair a three-line stacked headline (each line in a different weight) with a dark result card: a live badge, a big payoff number, and a line chart drawing upward across the card with a value pill springing up at its peak. This is the film's proof beat, make the climb feel earned.
